verdict: A bold clash of crisp administrative presentation paired with an absolute refusal to wear real shoes.
detailedQuote: Mr. Bari Ahmed presents a masterclass in hybrid academic efficiency, seamlessly balancing a crisp white button-up top with high-ventilation flip-flops. It is the ultimate sartorial choice for when you have a formal departmental meeting at 10 AM, but mentally you are already on summer vacation.
